findings.title: HTTPRoutes send the same hostname and path to different Services
findings.cause: HTTPRoute shop-canary claims shop.example.com with path prefix / (to Service storefront-v2; HTTPRoute shop sends it to Service storefront), on Gateway public: another route on the same Gateway already claims each of those, and the Gateway API gives a tie to the older route (or, created in the same second, the first by name), so shop-canary gets none of those requests
findings.fix: Give the routes different hostnames or paths, or merge them; for a canary, send one rule to both Services with weights on its backendRefs.
